verses.text: A song. A psalm by David. My heart is steady, God. I’ll sing and make music with everything in me.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I’ll wake the dawn.
I’ll thank you, LORD, among the nations and sing your praise among the peoples.
Your faithful love reaches higher than the heavens. Your faithfulness stretches to the skies.
Be exalted above the heavens, God! Let your glory cover the whole earth.
Save us with your right hand and answer us, so the people you love can be rescued.
God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I’ll triumph. I’ll divide Shechem and measure out the valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet, and Judah is my scepter.
Moab is my washbasin. I’ll toss my sandal over Edom, and I’ll shout in triumph over Philistia.”
Who’ll bring me into the fortified city? Who’ll lead me to Edom?
Haven’t you rejected us, God? You no longer march out with our armies.
Help us against the enemy, because human help won’t save us.
With God we’ll fight bravely, because he’ll trample our enemies.
